vcu_g_0159_2000338c.name: vehicle_telemetry_tail
vcu_g_0159_2000338c.description: Telemetry record, second half (0159 build, 0x2000338c..0x200033ad). vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update rewrites it with the head every 11th tick. It holds copies of protocol-owned words, 16-bit state values and the speed telemetry word (vehicle_speed_telemetry_a at +0x20). The gaps at +0x1a and +0x1c are not written in this build. The record ends with vehicle_snapshot_marker at +0x56 from the head.

vcu_g_153_200033a6.name: vehicle_snap153_marker
vcu_g_153_200033a6.description: 153 build only. End marker of the 153 telemetry record (record base 0x20003350, offset +0x56). vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update sets it to 0 after each snapshot. Same role as vehicle_snapshot_marker in the 0159 build.

vcu_g_0159_200033b6.name: vehicle_snapshot_marker
vcu_g_0159_200033b6.description: End marker of the 0159 telemetry record (record base 0x20003360, offset +0x56). vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update sets it to 3 after each snapshot. Probably a record-format or version tag; the consumer is not traced.
